title: Stuck in the queue
story: Your job {{jname}} has been pending for an hour while GPUs sit free. Find out why, and get it running.

lesson.title: Time limits per partition

parts.note: Shows each partition's TIMELIMIT: `gpu` 2 days, `short` 1 hour.
...but asks for 3 hours, which `short` never allows.

lesson.why: Slurm won't shorten your request or move the job for you.
lesson.without: The job waits forever with reason PartitionTimeLimit. Cancel it, fix the partition or the time, and resubmit.

files.~/{{project}}/{{jname}}.sh:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name={{jname}}
#SBATCH --partition=short
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --time=03:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%j.out

module load colabfold
colabfold_batch designs.fasta results/

hints: `squeue --me` gives the REASON. `sinfo` shows each partition's TIMELIMIT.

solution.text:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name={{jname}}
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
